answer: The nectar counter is kept in glacier and grove publishes each reset. An attacker thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1566 identities would post 2710 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
